title: Escape and recovery join tests
goal: The T01 join tests across runtime, ledger and runner before execution is enabled
acceptance: Escape (filesystem, network), credential denial, grader tampering, timeout and cancellation, worker recovery with uncertain effects
Each test fails on an unconfined runner (proved once with the enforcement turned off in a fixture)
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Join tests in CI on macOS; npm test
escalation: New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters
